describe: The image shows a cut-out rocket-launcher style gun. A long, flared bell-shaped barrel in polished copper and brass, with dark green-black shading underneath, leads back to a silver-grey receiver with a loop-shaped trigger guard and a dark brown grip. Small brass knobs and sight posts sit along the top. Transparent background: the flat mid-grey area around the gun is transparent. Lighting is bright from the upper left, with high contrast. Keep every part in its current position.
